descriptions.w3d_runtime_service_lookup: Forwards an integer lookup to the global context service virtual slot.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_service_query: Returns the global context service virtual query result.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_service_set_pair: Forwards two integers to the global context service virtual slot.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_service_set_byte_a: Passes a byte by address to the first global context service byte setter.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_service_set_byte_b: Passes a byte by address to the second global context service byte setter.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_singleton_construct: Constructs the base service, installs its virtual table, and stores the singleton.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_singleton_destroy: Runs service cleanup, clears its singleton, and destroys the base service.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_singleton_dispatch: Handles message sixty-four after base validation and delegates other messages to the base service.
descriptions.w3d_arguments_destroy: Releases stored strings and storage, then optionally deletes the argument owner.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_destroy_owned_resources: Destroys owned runtime state, releases held interfaces, and destroys its base without deleting it.
